name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
title: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd - 507526 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Own-brand IMFL grew 32% in FY26 with 22% Q4 margin, but management guides FY27 EBITDA to ~15% and IMFL margin to 15–17%; ethanol volumes fell 35% on industry oversupply.

utilisation.quote: we have enhanced our ENA production to 50 million liters from 47 million liters last year through higher plant efficiencies

capex.quote: INR 10 crores capex will be done in this unit for upliftment and modernization and automization of the plant.

triggers.label: Ethanol volume down 35% on oversupply
triggers.quote: This was largely due to the oversupply of ethanol industry due to excess capacity.

triggers.label: Proprietary IMFL volume +37% in Q4
triggers.quote: our proprietary IMFL portfolio has delivered 37% Y -o-Y volume growth

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA ~15% vs 17% Q4
triggers.quote: EBITDA guidance for '27 should be around in the range of 15%.

triggers.label: Packaging cost inflation from war
triggers.quote: the major impact which has come is the increase in the packaging material cost, primarily the PET bottles and paper and aluminum.

guidance.quote: EBITDA guidance for '27 should be around in the range of 15%.
We have planned around 10% double-digit growth, 10% plus revenue growth for next year, '27.
margin of IMFL proprietary side would be in the range of somewhere around 15% to 17%.
we expect to continue to grow at around 25% to 30%.
We are targeting to achieve 2 million cases this year annually.

red_flags.label: Ethanol segment EBIT loss; FY26 Rs 2.5 cr loss per analyst
red_flags.quote: on an EBIT basis, your segmental representation, which you have given , on an EBIT basis, Q4, it is a INR 6.5 crores loss

red_flags.label: Management guides margin lower on premium mix
red_flags.quote: it will not increase substantially from '28 onwards. It will increase from '29 onwards

red_flags.label: Tequila launch delayed
red_flags.quote: Although the tequila launch has witnessed a slight delay due to shipment related issues

evasions.quote: Yes, it is not as a remunerative.
to give a guidance on the revenue, which will come from the Kultur at this present state is very tough
